updates.sentence: The April 2, 1969 Panther 21 indictment occurred while Harris was already detained in New Jersey. His case was severed from the main trial. The former April 1, 1969 custody start and May 12, 1971 release were not supported as dates of this proceeding; no separate New York custody interval is established. The February 1969 New Jersey detention is recorded separately.

entries.rationale: Already jailed before indictment; no evidence main-trial verdict represents Harris discharge. Remove false exact interval and add separately documented NJ detention next batch.
